_about: Countries Walɔ runs in. Everything a country changes lives here, so the code contains no country: which coordinates are accepted, the money on Sell, the rain-season search windows, the zone names, the map, the labels on sources. Adding a country is a data change plus a check by someone who farms there. status "live" means that check has happened; "preview" means the data is complete enough to use but nobody farming there has checked it, and the app says so before you choose it; "draft" is never selectable.

bbox._note: Walɔ deliberately accepts a margin around the country so 'use my location' near a border still works; the nearest town still has to be in places.json.

major_search.note: No single standard start date for Ghana; Sivakumar (1988) searched from 1 May in the Sahel. Walɔ starts at 1 March so the forest and transition zones are not missed.

minor_search.note: Second (minor) season searched only in the bimodal zones (FAO zone text: forest, transition, coastal savanna).

zones._source: FAO Ghana agro-ecological zones (crop calendar region text)

KE.name: Kenya
KE._status_note: Preview: the planting windows come from the FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar and the Ministry of Agriculture cropping calendar in the Kenya Food Security Data Book, not from someone who farms there. The picker says so. It becomes "live" when checked_by_local is true.

bbox._note: The same margin around the country as Ghana, so 'use my location' near a border still works; the nearest town still has to be in places.json.

major_search.note: The long rains (masika) fall March-May, so Walɔ searches from 1 March. FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar 2024.

minor_search.note: The short rains (vuli) fall October-December and are the main season on the coast and in eastern Kenya. The highlands (KH) are treated as one long season, so no second search is made there.

zones._source: Kenya rainfall regimes from the FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar (long rains March-May, short rains October-December) and the Ministry of Agriculture cropping calendar in the Kenya Food Security Data Book 2025

KE.name: Eastern and coast, short rains main

sources.crop_calendar: FEWS NET Kenya seasonal calendar 2024 and Kenya Food Security Data Book 2025 (Ministry of Agriculture cropping calendar)
sources.prices: WFP market prices via HDX HAPI

NG.name: Nigeria
NG._status_note: Preview: planting windows come from IITA, Nigeria's NFHL crop guidance, the NE Nigeria seasonal calendar and an agro-ecological zone calendar, not from a farmer there. Prices come from WFP market prices via HDX HAPI. It becomes live when checked_by_local is true.

bbox._note: A margin around the country, as for Ghana and Kenya, so 'use my location' near a border still works; the nearest town still has to be in places.json.

major_search.note: Rains reach the south in March and the far north in July, so the search starts at 1 March and ends at 31 July. Source: NE Nigeria rainfed seasonal calendar and IITA maize planting dates.

minor_search.note: The south has a second (late) season planted August-September after the first maize; the northern zones have a single season.

zones._source: Nigeria agro-ecological zones: Sahel savanna, Sudan savanna, Northern Guinea savanna, Southern Guinea savanna, derived savanna, humid forest

sources.crop_calendar: IITA Guide to Maize Production in Northern Nigeria; Nigeria NFHL crop guidance; NE Nigeria rainfed seasonal calendar (FS Cluster/FAO); IITA Growing Cassava
sources.prices: WFP market prices via HDX HAPI
